messages:
oliver: ran a quick hardening/pass on staging base image; CIS + provenance checks show a few items: world-writable /tmp, openssl 1.1.1 flagged, missing cosign signatures on recent tags, and audit pipeline not capturing image pull events.

maya: copy. missing signatures are a gating issue. is cosign failing or the signer not invoked?

oliver: bake logs show cosign error "permission denied" during upload to KMS-backed signer. suspect RBAC change.

ben: who touched the builder role? @zoe?

zoe: I narrowed the builder role last sprint to remove broad kms.sign across projects. I did not realize bake used builder principal for cosign. I can add a limited binding: kms.keys.sign on projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/cosign-key scoped to serviceAccount:ci-builder@redwood-prod. Add expiry tag?

maya: yes add expiry + a PR note. Also make bake explicit-fail when cosign fails. snippet suggestion:

```
if ! cosign verify --key k8s://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/cosign-key ${IMAGE_URI}; then
  echo "PROVENANCE FAIL: unsigned image"; exit 1
fi
```

oliver: agreed. migration question: do we rebuild all unsigned images or retag/resign?

ben: rebuild+repush preferred for provenance. Re-signing in-place loses build metadata and breaks attestation timelines.

zoe: I'll open the RBAC PR with an auto-expire label and include rollback steps (how to remove the binding). Linking in description with runbook steps.

maya: audit pipeline note: we only ship kubelet start/stop. Security wants registry pull/create events for timelines. We can enable containerd event forwarding in audit sidecar with a filter to only forward pull/create and registry metadata.

ben: sample config to test in staging:

```
audit.forwarders.containerd.enabled: true
audit.forwarders.containerd.events: ["pull","create"]
audit.filters: [{"event":"pull","fields": ["image","digest","node","namespace"]}]
shipper.endpoint: https://audit-shipper.internal/ingest
```

zoe: test first in staging; if traffic spikes we'll add sampling. I'll also add these changes to the canary checklist.

sec-bot: infra-scan: staging/base-image:2028-03-15 -> failed CIS checks (6). full report: https://ci.internal/scans/3571234567

oliver: thanks. Maya 609 can you own the rebuild runway? propose Sat 02:00-04:00 PT, canary to prod after verifier passes.

maya: yes I'll take it. will include steps: bake with verify, sign via new binding, smoke canary, then promote. rollback: remove binding (gcloud iam policy remove-iam-policy-binding ...), quarantine tags in registry, revert bake change.

zoe: PR opened for RBAC fix: https://git.internal/redwood/iam/PR-4921. tagging @oliver @maya for quick approval. includes expiry and rollback instructions.

oliver: great. once PR lands I'll trigger rebuild and post results. thanks team.
